description: Work out what a private-sector worker is owed when a job ends in Saudi Arabia, the UAE or Qatar: end-of-service award or gratuity, unpaid wages, unused leave and overtime, each line with its labour-law article, plus a claim summary. Uses GlanceDesk Jurisdiction's tested engine.

basic_monthly_wage.description: Last basic monthly wage, without allowances (SAR, AED or QAR). The UAE and Qatar gratuity and leave pay use this.

country.description: sa = Saudi Arabia (Labor Law, Royal Decree M/51), ae = United Arab Emirates (Federal Decree-Law 33 of 2021, private sector), qa = Qatar (Labour Law, Law No. 14 of 2004).

how_it_ended.description: employer = the employer ended the contract (not for misconduct); expired = fixed-term contract ended, not renewed; resign = the worker resigned; breach = the worker left because the employer broke the contract or law (Saudi Art. 81, UAE Art. 45); exception = Saudi only: force majeure, or a female worker leaving within 6 months of marriage or 3 months of giving birth; misconduct = dismissed without notice for a reason the law lists (Saudi Art. 80, UAE Art. 44, Qatar Art. 61).

last_day.description: Last day of work, YYYY-MM-DD. Both days count as service.

night_overtime_hours.description: UAE or Qatar, optional: how many of the overtime hours were at night (UAE 10 pm to 4 am, Qatar 9 pm to 3 am; not for shift workers).

normal_hours_per_day.description: Needed only with overtime: normal working hours per day in the contract.

total_monthly_wage.description: Last total monthly wage: basic plus contractual allowances. The Saudi award and leave pay use this. Must be at least the basic wage.

unpaid_absence_days.description: UAE only, optional: days of unpaid absence (not counted as service).

unpaid_wage_months.description: Optional. Months of wages not paid (decimals for part months).

unused_leave_days.description: Optional. Unused annual leave days earned, including this year's share.
